lines: Act natural. I'm not here.
Nobody saw me. Two stars.
I'm just browsing. Violently.
This visit will be reflected in your scores.
leader.name: Agnes Clipboard-Hale

lines: Is this... is this the test?
I'm also not here!
She said blend in. I'm blending.
Do I write this down or punch it?

entrance: A woman in very large sunglasses has entered the {arena}. Nobody knows why. She's taking notes.
Wait, who are they? Agnes Clipboard-Hale, Mystery Shopper, is 'just browsing' straight into the fight.
posts: Visited the {arena} today, entirely anonymously. Staff were fighting. Customer service: one star. Fighting: four. #MysteryShopper #Feedback
Report on today's {arena} visit: no greeting at the door, three people threw a melon at me. Would return. #CustomerExperience
Disguise held for 40 seconds. A personal best. The {company} lot never suspected a thing (they were busy losing).
comments: I was also undercover. Nobody noticed me either. Or helped me up.
Do we get expenses for the melon?
Agnes, are we allowed to post this? Isn't the whole point that we're secret?
Still in the sunglasses. Can't find my car.

lines: Nobody leaves a trolley in MY bay!
That's a pound coin's worth of disrespect.
Line 'em up. Nose to tail.
I've pushed forty trolleys uphill. I can push you.
leader.name: Big Kev Pushworth

lines: Train of trolleys coming through!
Kev said get stuck in!
WHEEEE!
Hi-vis means I'm allowed.

entrance: A rattling noise from the car park... it's Big Kev, Trolley Marshal, and he's brought a train of forty trolleys!
Here come the Trolley Marshals! Somebody left a trolley outside bay 6 and now we ALL pay.
posts: Forty trolleys returned to the bay today and four people returned to the floor. Productive shift. #Hustle #CarParkLife
Found a fight in the {arena} with NO trolley discipline. Fixed it. #Leadership #LineThemUp
People ask what a Trolley Marshal does. Today I showed the {company} lot. They won't ask again.
comments: Kev that was mint
Can I drive the trolley train next time?
Lost a wheel. Not mine. Somebody's.
Still smell of car park. Proud.

lines: We're not here to fire anyone. Today.
Let's circle back to the punching.
I'm seeing a lot of inefficiency in this fight.
Have you considered being restructured?
leader.name: Tristan Vale

lines: I've made a deck about you.
Billable! This is billable!
Per my last punch...
Slide 47: your downfall.

entrance: The doors swing open: Tristan Vale, Change Management Consultant, and his associates. They charge £4,000 a day. Today they charge everyone.
Oh no. Consultants. They've drawn a two-by-two matrix and everyone in the {arena} is in the bottom-left.
posts: Productive engagement at the {arena} today. Key finding: too many people were standing up. We've optimised that. #Transformation #ChangeManagement
Our invoice for today's fight is in the post. It's mostly for the chair I threw. #ValueAdd
Three learnings from today's {arena} brawl (a thread). 1. Synergy is a contact sport. 2. {company} are not agile. 3. Invoice attached.
comments: Slides are in the shared drive. Slide 12 is just a picture of a bruise.
Can I bill the ambulance time?
Tristan, the client is asking what 'right-sizing them' meant.
I learned so much today. Mostly about falling.

lines: Have you tried turning it off and on again?
Who unplugged the server? WHO?
I'm going to need you to restart. Your face.
Ticket closed. Problem solved.
leader.name: Gary from IT

lines: Is this the cable? Is THIS?
Gary said just hit it till it works!
Sorry, did you raise a ticket?
I'm on the helpdesk rota AND the fight rota.

entrance: Somebody unplugged the printer. Gary from IT has arrived, and he has NOT had his lunch.
IT Support in the {arena}! They've heard the words 'quick question' one too many times.
posts: Responded to an urgent ticket in the {arena} today (priority 'someone is punching the router'). Resolved. #ITLife #HaveYouTriedTurningItOff
Turned four people off and on again. Two of them came back on. #TechSupport
Reminder: the {company} team's request to 'please stop fighting near the server' is now ticket #4471. Expected response: never.
comments: I didn't unplug it, Gary. Well. I did. But in a fighting way.
Raising a ticket about my back.
Gary can I go home it's 5:01
The printer is still broken btw

lines: Nobody move. Is that a HAIR?
Gloves! Where are your GLOVES?
This fight is a two out of five.
I'm shutting you down. Personally.
leader.name: Mona Grubb

lines: Hold still, I need a swab.
Ooh, that's growing something.
Inspector, I found another fridge!
It's for science. And for fighting.

entrance: Clipboards up! The Health Inspector has walked into the {arena}. Everyone is suddenly washing their hands. Mid-fight.
It's Inspector Mona Grubb and her swab deputies. She's already found a hair. It's on someone's head. Still counts.
posts: Inspection report, {arena}: hygiene 1/5, fighting 5/5. Temporary closure issued to the {company} team's faces. #FoodSafety #Standards
I've seen dirtier kitchens. Not many. Not today. Not after we were done. #Inspection
Swabbed seven surfaces and four fighters today. Results pending. Smells conclusive.
comments: The swabs are in the van. One of them moved.
Mona, do we have to fill in a form for the trifle?
Should we have told them we were coming?
That was my best inspection yet. I'm bleeding.

lines: This is taco territory now.
Nobody serves lunch on my patch!
Extra spicy? Oh, you'll get extra spicy.
My truck, my rules, my salsa.
leader.name: Don Taco Delgado

lines: Squeeze bottle locked and loaded!
Mild, medium or MAYHEM?
The Don sends his regards!
You want sauce? You GET sauce.

entrance: You hear the jingle of a food truck... it's Don Taco Delgado, the Food Truck Kingpin, and this {arena} serves lunch on HIS patch!
The Food Truck Mafia rolls in! Somebody undercut them on burritos and now everybody's on the menu.
posts: Expanded into a new territory today: the {arena}. Customers were reluctant. Then they were on the floor. #SmallBusiness #Entrepreneur
Mild, medium or mayhem? Today the {company} team picked mayhem. It's not on the menu any more. #FoodTruckLife
Lunch service at the {arena}: 3 tacos sold, 4 fighters served. #Hospitality
comments: Boss I ran out of sauce halfway through
The truck has a parking ticket again
Don, can we go back to just selling tacos
Squeeze bottle's broken. Totally worth it.

lines: Mind the gap. The gap is me.
This service is now terminating. You.
Delays are expected. Mostly yours.
Leaves on the line? I AM the leaves.
leader.name: Doug Platt

lines: Tickets, please. ALL of them.
That's a penalty fare, sunshine.
Off-peak ticket on a peak fight?
Railcard? Didn't think so.

entrance: Ding-dong! 'The train now arriving is the 07:42 service, calling at: this fight.' Driver Doug Platt and the ticket inspectors are here!
Here comes the 07:42! Twelve minutes late, and furious about it.
posts: The 07:42 called at the {arena} today. Unscheduled stop. Passengers were 'assisted' off. We apologise for any inconvenience. #Rail #Delays
Ran over schedule at the {arena}. Ran over the {company} team too. #TrainLife #MindTheGap
Reminder: fighting without a valid ticket carries a penalty fare. Today's penalty: everything.
comments: Checked 14 tickets. Fined 14 people. One was a pigeon.
Doug we've left the train running
Do we get overtime for the fight?
That was a peak-time beating. Full fare.

lines: Your train is now a bus. Your fight is now MY fight.
Please follow the signs. The signs are me.
Next stop: an hour from now, somewhere else.
Engineering works! Stand back!
leader.name: Brenda Diversion

lines: This way. No. That way.
Have you seen the sign? I am the sign.
Queue here. Queue THERE.
Are you on the replacement bus? You are now.

entrance: Engineering works in the {arena}! Brenda Diversion from Rail Replacement and her hi-vis marshals are rerouting this fight. Somewhere worse.
Sorry, this fight is now being replaced by a bus. Brenda's in charge, and the bus is on fire.
posts: Replacement service ran smoothly at the {arena} today. Nobody knew where to go, which is the standard. #Rail #CustomerJourney
Diverted the {company} team via the floor. Journey time: one second. #EngineeringWorks
Today's rail replacement went to the {arena}. Nobody asked it to. That's the service.
comments: I pointed at nothing for 3 hours. Proud.
Brenda the bus is still in the car park, should we
Who took my lollipop sign
I directed traffic AND punches. Multi-skilled.

lines: Nobody touches anything until I've counted it.
That's one. Two. You moved. Start again.
Discrepancy detected. You.
This fight is NOT in the inventory.
leader.name: Margaret Tally

lines: BEEP. You've been scanned.
Item not recognised. Reboot.
Unexpected item in the fighting area!
I scan, therefore I am.

entrance: Freeze! It's stocktake. Margaret Tally, Auditor, is in the {arena}, and nobody's leaving till everything's counted. Including teeth.
Here comes Stocktake! Margaret Tally has counted every fighter. The numbers are about to go down.
posts: Stocktake at the {arena} complete. Opening count: 6 fighters. Closing count: lower. Variance attributed to {company}. #Audit #Inventory
Counted to 4,212 today, then someone knocked the clipboard out of my hand. Starting again Monday. #Stocktake
Discrepancies found today: 1 missing pallet, 3 missing teeth. Reported.
comments: BEEP
My scanner thinks the {company} lot are bananas
Margaret, we're 2 people short. Is that us?
I scanned a fist. Unknown item.

lines: Everybody out! ...After this.
This fight breaches the agreement!
Tea break is a human right!
Solidarity! And a slap.
leader.name: Big Sal Strickland

lines: All in favour of punching?
Motion carried!
Sal's got the floor. And so will you.
No fighting without a union rep present. I'm present.

entrance: Whistles blow! Big Sal Strickland, Union Rep, is here: someone's been fighting without a proper tea break!
The Union's here! And this fight is officially a dispute.
posts: Represented the workers of the {arena} today. They didn't ask. Solidarity doesn't ask. #Union #WorkersRights
Today's negotiation with the {company} team went well. They're lying down. #CollectiveBargaining
Motion: no more fighting without a tea break. Carried unanimously by everyone still standing.
comments: Seconded!
Sal I think the vote was 2 to 4 actually
Tea break was unfairly cut short by a forklift
Picket line holding. Mostly holding. One fell over.

lines: This fight does not have planning permission!
Objection lodged. With my fist.
Section 14b. Look it up.
You need a permit for that face.
leader.name: Gordon Pruitt

lines: Hold this tape measure. With your face.
That's three metres of nope.
Everything here is in violation!
Plumb line! PLUMB LINE!

entrance: Hold everything! The council's here. Councillor Gordon Pruitt says this fight is 'not in keeping with the character of the area'.
Planning Permission has arrived, and this {arena} brawl has NOT been approved. Appeals take six weeks. Punches take one.
posts: Site visit to the {arena} today. Unauthorised fighting found. Enforcement action taken (by hand). #LocalGovernment #Planning
The {company} team applied for permission to win today. Application refused. #Council
Reminder that all fighting requires a permit, a fee, and a 6-week consultation period. Or Gordon.
comments: Measured the fight. It's 4m over the limit.
Gordon the theodolite is bent now
Can we put 'punched a builder' on the timesheet?
Objection noted. Objection also bruised.

lines: Tea break's over. So are you.
I can see your house from up there. It's next.
Load incoming! The load is me!
Hard hats ON. Faces OFF.
leader.name: Mick 'Hook' O'Hara

lines: Is it break time? It's always break time.
Hold my tea.
Mick said come down, so I came down.
Wolf-whistles are banned. Punches aren't.

entrance: Something large swings into view... it's Mick 'Hook' O'Hara, Crane Operator, and his tea-break crew!
The Crane Gang are here! Somebody parked under the crane again.
posts: Climbed down from the crane for the first time this year to sort out the {arena}. Worth it. #Construction #Lifting
Lifted 4 tonnes today. And the {company} team, briefly. #CraneLife
Hard hats on, faces off. Good day at the {arena}.
comments: Back up the crane Mick, the boss is looking
My tea went cold during the fight. Unforgivable.
I held the tea the whole time. Didn't spill a drop.
Someone tell Mick the crane's still swinging

lines: Anything to declare? Besides defeat?
This container is now evidence. So are you.
Step aside, please. Further. Into the floor.
I'll need to see some ID. And some fear.
leader.name: Hilda Stamp

lines: Rex has found something! It's you!
Good boy. GOOD boy. Get 'em.
He can smell guilt.
Sit. Stay. Fight.

entrance: Customs! Officer Hilda Stamp has found something suspicious in the {arena}: a fight. With undeclared punches.
The Customs Raid is here, and the sniffer dogs are very excited about the {arena}.
posts: Routine inspection of the {arena} today. Seized: 3 undeclared punches, 1 suspicious pallet, the {company} team. #Customs #BorderForce
Nothing to declare? The {company} team had plenty to declare by the end. Mostly 'ow'.
Proud of Rex today. He found 4 people and a sandwich.
comments: Rex ate the evidence
Hilda, do we have to fill in a seizure form for the forklift?
Good boy. Me, not the dog.
Two biscuits, one KO. Rex is having a career year.

lines: Smell that? That's victory. And mackerel.
I've wrestled tuna bigger than you.
Gut 'em and grade 'em!
Fresh catch! Fresh FIGHT!
leader.name: Barnaby Sole

lines: Slippery! Slippery!
Have a haddock!
The Captain's in a mood. Again.
I've got a fish in each hand and I'm not afraid to use them.

entrance: A foghorn blows! Captain Barnaby Sole and his gutting crew have come ashore, and they smell like a decision.
The Fishmongers are here! Something in the {arena} insulted the catch of the day.
posts: Landed at the {arena} today. Biggest catch: the {company} team. Threw two back. #Fishing #FreshCatch
Smell that? That's me. Still. Three days later. Worth it.
Today's catch: 4 fighters, 1 haddock, 0 regrets. #SeaLife
comments: Captain I've lost a fish. Somewhere in there.
The haddock was a real team player
Still finding scales in my ears
Slippery day at the office

lines: I'm buying this fight. Then shorting it.
Everyone in this room is a liability.
Synergise THIS.
My lawyer will be in touch. He's behind me.
leader.name: Sterling Vance III

lines: Yes, Mr Vance. Right away, Mr Vance.
He's not angry, he's disappointed. And angry.
I'll need you to sign here. With your blood.
Mr Vance would like you to fall over now.

entrance: A limousine parks across three spaces. Sterling Vance III, Hedge Fund Owner, has bought the {arena}. And the fight. And the referee's whistle.
The Hedge Fund are here! Somebody's portfolio just went down. It's everyone's.
posts: Acquired the {arena} today, for about an hour. Restructured the {company} team. Exited at a profit. #Finance #Leadership
Short position on the {company} team paid off nicely today. They were very short by the end. #Markets
Today I learned violence is a diversified asset. #ThoughtLeadership
comments: Mr Vance, the limo's been clamped
I've drafted the press release, sir. It says 'no comment' 40 times.
Sir, the hotel would like you to stop owning it
Fetching the car, Mr Vance! Again, Mr Vance!

lines: It's MY special day and you're IN it!
Somebody get me a prosecco! And a chair! To throw!
Last night of freedom, girls!
Nobody upstages the BRIDE.
leader.name: Kayleigh Fairweather

lines: Don't you DARE ruin her day!
I didn't fly in from Malaga for this!
Sash on. Gloves off.
Hen party coming through!

entrance: WOOO! The doors burst open: it's Kayleigh's hen party, and they've lost the coach driver, the plot and three shoes. Nobody is safe.
Oh no. A hen party has stumbled into the {arena}. L-plates on, gloves off.
posts: Best. Hen. EVER. Somebody please tell me what happened in the {arena}?? 💍🥂 #HenDo #NoRegrets
Shoutout to the {company} team for joining my hen party uninvited. You will not be invited to the wedding. #Bridezilla
I lost a shoe in the {arena}. If found, keep it, it's cursed now.
comments: Kayleigh I've lost my sash AND my voice
Who invited the ref?? He was a laugh tbh
Has anyone seen Big Lou? Last seen holding a chair
Never again. Same time next week?

lines: I brought grapes. They're for throwing.
Visiting hours are NOW, dear.
Have you eaten? You look peaky.
I've visited everyone in this hospital. Twice.
leader.name: Nana Edith Bunch

lines: Nana, can we go now?
I'm SO bored. Let's fight.
Nana said I can have a sweet if I win.
Is that a wheelchair? Can I ride it?

entrance: It's visiting hours! Nana Edith has arrived with grapes, a balloon and two very bored grandchildren.
Visiting Hours in the {arena}! Nana Edith only wanted to drop off some grapes. She's going to drop off a lot more.
posts: Lovely visit to the {arena} today. Brought grapes, left bruises. The young {company} people really should eat more. #Grandma #Visiting
Hello dear, is this the Facebook? I hit a man today. He was very rude about my grapes.
Told the {company} lot to sit up straight. They lay down instead. Kids today.
comments: Nana can we go home now
Nana this is LinkedIn
I got the sweet!!
Nana threw the grapes at a referee

lines: Have you heard about our new side effects?
Free pens for everyone! Pointy end first.
Ask your doctor if punching is right for you.
Results may vary. Mostly bruising.
leader.name: Chad Pfennig

lines: Free pen? FREE PEN?
Chad says hand these out. Hard.
This lanyard has a logo on it!
Side effects include: me.

entrance: Somebody's wheeling in a trolley of free samples: it's Chad Pfennig, Pharmaceutical Sales Rep, and he has a quota to hit. Literally.
The Pharma Rep's here! Free pens, free lanyards, free concussion.
posts: Great day networking at the {arena}! Handed out 300 pens and 12 punches. #Pharma #Sales #Quota
Side effects of meeting me today included dizziness, falling over and losing to {company}. Speak to your doctor.
Exceeded quota! The quota was 'disrupt the {arena}'.
comments: Chad we're out of pens
Do the punches count towards the bonus?
I think someone stole the trolley
Free pen interns are a family 💙

lines: Line up in twos. Then ATTACK in twos.
I can wait. I can wait all day.
Whoever's chewing gum: you're next.
Lunch boxes away, fists out!
leader.name: Mrs Pickering

lines: I only came to hold the clipboard!
Has anyone seen Oliver? OLIVER?
Is this the gift shop?
Mrs Pickering said I can hit people if they push.

entrance: A whistle! Mrs Pickering's school trip has taken a wrong turn into the {arena}. She's counted her helpers. She's counting YOU.
It's the School Trip! Mrs Pickering has lost a child, a packed lunch and her patience.
posts: Wonderful trip to the {arena} with Year 4 today. Learning objective: 'teamwork'. We demonstrated it on the {company} team. #Education #Teacher
Reminder to parents: trip letters were due on Friday. Also, don't fight Mrs Pickering.
No children were harmed. Several adults were. Back on the coach by 3.
comments: Oliver was in the gift shop the whole time
I'd like a word about the permission slip
Can I be a parent helper again? That was cathartic
Mrs Pickering is my hero

lines: I've seen things in this museum. Now you'll see me.
Who goes there? Oh. Everyone.
Torch on. Gloves off.
The exhibits are moving again. Help.
leader.name: Reg Lantern

lines: Do not touch the exhibits. The exhibits will touch YOU.
I have been standing still for 200 years.
Melt? MELT?

entrance: The lights flicker... Reg Lantern, Night Watchman, stumbles in, followed by two wax figures who have absolutely come to life.
It's the Night Watch! Reg says the exhibits 'just started walking'. They also just started punching.
posts: Another quiet night at the {arena}. Two wax figures came to life and beat up the {company} team. Normal. #NightShift #Security
I just want to state for the record: I did not let them out. They let themselves out.
My shift ends at 6. The exhibits' shifts apparently don't.
comments: Reg I've melted a bit
The museum would like its kings back
Napoleon was SHORT but he was effective

lines: Have you tried 'Defeat' by Valentina?
One spritz and you'll be on the floor.
Tax-free! Punch-free? Never.
Smell is the first thing they notice. Then the punch.
leader.name: Valentina Spritz

lines: Free sample! FREE SAMPLE!
Wrist? Neck? Eyes?
Smell this. No, really. SMELL it.
Are you travelling today? You are now.

entrance: A cloud of perfume rolls into the {arena}... Valentina Spritz, Duty Free Perfume Counter Queen, and two over-eager tester sprayers!
Duty Free is here! Everyone in the {arena} is getting a free sample, whether they like it or not.
posts: Brought the Duty Free experience to the {arena} today. Everyone smelled amazing on the way down. #Luxury #Fragrance
Introducing my new fragrance, 'Defeat', modelled today by the {company} team. #Launch
The {arena} smells so much better now. You're welcome.
comments: My eyes still sting
Valentina I've emptied six bottles
Somebody bought a candle mid-fight??
The ref smells like vanilla now. Proud.

lines: Your bag went to Lisbon. You're going down.
Fragile? Not any more.
I just throw them. That's the job.
Overweight! Extra charge! In punches!
leader.name: Terry Carousel

lines: Mind the carousel!
This bag's ticking. Is your bag ticking?
Heavy! Catch!
No label? Straight to the pile.

entrance: A luggage carousel squeaks to life... Terry Carousel, Head Baggage Handler, and his crew have lost someone's bag. In the {arena}.
Lost Luggage! Terry's here to throw things. That's the job, apparently.
posts: Handled 4,000 bags today and 4 people. Same technique. #Aviation #Logistics
If you lost a bag at the {arena} today, it's now in Lisbon. So are the {company} team, emotionally.
Fragile stickers are a suggestion. #BaggageHandler
comments: Terry someone's bag was full of cheese
I threw a suitcase AND a man today
We're on our break now right
The carousel is still going round with someone on it

lines: Dreadful. Unwatchable. I'll stay till the end.
One star. And that's for the lighting.
I've seen better fights at a funeral.
Derivative! Overacted! Let me in.
leader.name: Lady Penelope Scathe

lines: I KNOW all the lines!
This is my big break!
I've been waiting in the wings for years!
Is the lead injured? I can be the lead.

entrance: A program rustles... Lady Penelope Scathe, Theatre Critic, has arrived to review this fight. She already hates it.
The Critics are here! Lady Penelope has written her review. Now she's going to make it come true.
posts: Review: 'Brawl at the {arena}'. A tedious first act, a muddled middle, then I got involved. Four stars. #Theatre #Review
The {company} team's performance was wooden, unconvincing and mostly horizontal. One star.
Finally, a production with conflict. Shame about the cast.
comments: I went on for the second act!!
Penelope my agent wants to know if this was paid
Understudy life: waiting for someone to fall over. Today: everyone did.
Encore? Please no.

lines: Oh yes I am!
He's behind you! No, really, he IS.
Hello boys and girls! And goodbye.
My wig's coming off and so are the gloves.
leader.name: Dame Trevor Twankey

lines: Neigh?
Which way is forward?!
I'm the BACK half. Show some respect.
Clip-clop. Clip-CLOP.

entrance: Oh no it isn't! Oh yes it is! Dame Trevor Twankey and both halves of a pantomime horse have arrived in the {arena}!
It's Panto Season! Look out! They're behind you! No, really, turn around.
posts: Oh yes I DID take on the {company} team at the {arena} today! Oh no they DIDN'T win! #Panto #ItsBehindYou
Brought a little sparkle to the {arena} today. And a lot of custard. #Theatre
Thank you to my horse, both halves, for their commitment. #Panto
comments: Neigh
Trev the back half's gone missing
Front half here. Back half is NOT speaking to me.
Oh no it wasn't! (It was.)
